faq_heading: Homes near Brookside Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Brookside Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Brookside Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Brookside Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Brookside Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Enver Creek Secondary (0.6 km south-east), Green Timbers Elementary (0.7 km north-east) and Janice Churchill Elementary (1.0 km south-east).

Brookside Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 8555 142a St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Brookside Elementary in the listing.
How the Brookside Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Brookside Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Brookside Elementary

29 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Brookside Elementary in a straight line (18 elementary, 8 secondary, 3 other; 4 independent). The closest is Enver Creek Secondary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Coyote Creek Elementary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Green Timbers Elementary (0.7 km); the nearest independent school is Cornerstone Montessori School (1.0 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Simon Cunningham Elementary (1.7 km). Other elementary schools close by: Green Timbers Elementary (0.7 km north-east), Janice Churchill Elementary (1.0 km south-east), Cornerstone Montessori School (1.0 km east), Maple Green Elementary (1.3 km east), Creekside Elementary (1.4 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Green Timbers Elementary, 0.7 km north-east of Brookside Elementary.
